# Petteri Helttula

> Portfolio of Petteri Helttula ("Petu"), a Helsinki-based product, data and AI builder (B.Eng. in ICT Engineering, Metropolia UAS). He bridges data analytics, AI tools and user experience — turning complex data into usable products, validating assumptions with domain knowledge and users, and building working prototypes with AI agents.

For a complete, single-file Markdown summary of background, skills, target roles and all case studies, see [llms-full.txt](https://www.petu.design/llms-full.txt).

## Main site

- [Portfolio](https://www.petu.design/): Selected work, other projects and about section.
- [Full LLMs Dossier](https://www.petu.design/llms-full.txt): Background, education, target roles, core skills and detailed case study summaries.

## Currently building

- [Havain](https://www.petu.design/havain/): Computer vision and GS1 2D barcode system turning grocery shelves into structured data, starting with expiry and food waste. Includes a day-by-day shelf simulation, phone prototype and maintenance centre demo.

## Selected case studies

- [Kelikamera AI](https://www.petu.design/kelikamera/): Live map of Finland's 800 Fintraffic road weather cameras, collecting winter 2026–27 image and sensor pairs to train a local road-condition and friction estimation model for the 475 cameras with no surface sensor.
- [Maamitta](https://www.petu.design/maamitta/): Map measurement, material estimator and PDF quote tool for Finnish landscaping, earthworks, paving and fencing contractors. Pick an official MML parcel with automatic building subtraction, draw partial yards or 3.5 m/4.0 m driveways, combine multiple zones and export PDF quotes, 4-line WhatsApp summaries, GeoJSON or KML. Live at https://maamitta.pages.dev/.
- [KorisLab](https://www.petu.design/korislab/): Basketball analytics platform for women's and men's Korisliiga (692 games, 566 players, 96,019 shot attempts), featuring 1,000x Monte Carlo game simulation, play-by-play replay, matchup comparisons and natural-language season search.
- [Peluutin](https://www.petu.design/peluutin/): Mobile playing-time tracker and 2D/3D training exercise planner built with two junior football coaches, used across 4+ months and 20+ matches in football and futsal.
- [Helsinki Sports Map](https://www.petu.design/helsinki-sports-map/): Mobile-first map uniting 1,344 Helsinki sports venues across 178 districts from 3 open data sources (LIPAS, 1,065 Helsinki Service Map units, Paikkatietohaku) with walking, cycling, driving and HSL public transport routing, Meet-halfway search between two districts, and a manual data-review queue.

## Other projects

- [Tahti](https://www.petu.design/tahti/): Chrome extension that paces selected text one word at a time to reduce visual load when reading dense text.
- [S-hävikki](https://www.petu.design/s-havikki/): Grocery food-waste service concept shaped by four years on a hypermarket dairy shop floor (predecessor to Havain).
- Vilt (in progress): Maps wildlife collisions in Finland and Norway, forecasts risk and identifies where new wildlife fences would save the most.
